Now, about Elvis Presley's manager - Andreas Cornelis van Kujik was actually born in the Netherlands but reinvented himself in America. He became famous under the name "Colonel Tom Parker" (though the "Colonel" was an honorary title, not a military rank). He managed Elvis from 1955 until Elvis's death in 1977 and was known for his shrewd, sometimes controversial business dealings.
